about.title: Modern Comfort. Scenic Retreats. Hosts Who Care.
story: We met in Atlanta more than [12] years ago, got married at a destination wedding in Mexico, and have been chasing adventures together ever since. Today we're a family of four, plus three rescue dogs, and life is a happy blur of [Emmy's activities], [Leo's activities] and weekends away whenever we can get them.

BK Stays started in [year] with [our first home]. What began as one cabin has grown to 14 homes across Georgia, Florida, Michigan and Minnesota, and we still care for every one of them like it's our own getaway.
Brandon grew up in Iowa, played college football and has spent his career in sports, [current role]. Katharina is a dual citizen, born and raised in Germany, and [current role].

favorites.title: Cherry Log Summit
favorites.text: Leo would spend every weekend at the cabin if he could, and his dad is usually right there with him. With a fully fenced-in yard, jacuzzi, outdoor playground and game room, Cherry Log Summit is our top pick for families traveling with kids.

favorites.title: Havana Haven
favorites.text: Emmy never passes up a beach trip, and a girls' getaway with mom to Fort Lauderdale is her favorite kind. With its large heated pool and the beach only a mile away, Havana Haven has a special place in her heart.

quotes: Working with BK Stays has been nothing short of transformational for our short term rental property. From the very beginning, they provided invaluable feedback that directly contributed to an increase in bookings and overall 5-star customer satisfaction rating.
What sets BK Stays apart is their unwavering commitment to a customer-backed approach. Every decision they make centers on ensuring that guests are not only satisfied but genuinely delighted.
BK Stays is also unmatched in their responsiveness and professionalism. Any question, concern, or request we've had has been met with prompt and thorough responses.

meet: Brandon and Katharina's journey began over 10 years ago in Atlanta, where they met and quickly became partners in life and business. After a destination wedding in Mexico, their family grew with their daughter, Emmy, and son, Leo, plus three rescue dogs.

Brandon, originally from Iowa, has a deep background in sports and has worked in college athletics since moving to Atlanta. Katharina, a dual citizen born and raised in Germany, is the Director of the German Desk for an international recruiting and consulting firm. Together, they've built a property management business grounded in family values and exceptional service.
